title: Fireworks display over a night harbor
prompt: Build a single-page browser app with the provided framework, served by vite, rendering to the canvas with id #app. The scene is a fireworks display at night over a calm harbor. Show a dark star-dusted night sky, a water surface that faintly reflects the light of the bursts, and a low dark silhouette of a shoreline or pier with a few small buildings or boats. Rockets launch from the shoreline one after another at irregular intervals, rise with a short glowing trail, and burst into spherical shells of many glowing sparks. Use at least three clearly different burst colors (for example gold, red, and blue or green), and make each burst fade and fall under gravity over a second or two before it disappears. Some bursts should leave trailing streaks. The sky and water should be lit subtly by the active bursts. The scene must animate continuously without user input, with a slow gentle camera drift or a fixed camera framing the sky and harbor. Aim for a polished, cinematic look: strong glow on the sparks against a dark background, no flat or washed-out colors, no visible geometry artifacts. Keep it smooth at interactive frame rates. Also expose window.__TASK_STATE__ = { bursts: <total number of bursts that have exploded so far>, activeParticles: <current number of live spark particles> } and update it every frame.
functionalChecklist: Single-page app boots with vite and renders to the canvas with id #app without console errors
Scene contains a night sky background plus a water surface and a shoreline or pier silhouette (verifiable in source or in frame)
Rockets are launched automatically on a timer with randomized intervals (no user input required)
Each rocket rises with a visible trail and then explodes into a burst of at least 50 spark particles
At least three distinct burst colors are defined and used in source
Sparks are affected by gravity and fade out or are removed after a limited lifetime (no unbounded particle growth)
Glow or bloom-like emphasis is applied so sparks read as luminous against the dark scene
window.__TASK_STATE__.bursts increases over time and activeParticles stays bounded (probe: bursts >= 3 within 20 s, activeParticles > 0 at some sample)
Water or sky shows a response (reflection, tint, or light flash) to bursts
visualRubric: A strong frame shows a dark, cinematic night scene with at least one or two bursts mid-expansion in clearly different saturated colors, each made of many distinct glowing sparks with soft halos and fading trails. Score 1-5 on each: (1) Burst quality and density: spherical, well-distributed sparks with trails, not sparse dots or flat discs. (2) Glow and color: luminous, saturated sparks with convincing bloom against a dark sky, color variety across bursts. (3) Environment: believable harbor with water reflections and shoreline silhouette that frames the sky and is lit subtly by the bursts. (4) Composition and depth: bursts at varied heights and distances, good use of the frame, no empty or cluttered frame. (5) Polish and artifacts: no clipping, hard-edged squares, banding, or overexposed white-out; stays coherent across several frames.
probe: Frame-difference motion check: capture 6 frames at 500 ms intervals (about 3 s) after a 2 s warm-up; compute mean absolute per-pixel difference between consecutive frames on a downscaled grayscale image. Pass if the mean difference is above a small threshold (for example > 0.5 percent of full range) in at least 4 of 5 pairs, and the frame is not blank (mean luminance > 2 and < 60 on 0-255, with the brightest 1 percent of pixels above 200 in at least one frame). Optionally read window.__TASK_STATE__ at the first and last capture and require bursts to increase and activeParticles to be a finite number below 50000.

title: Magic portal with swirling particles and glow
prompt: Build a single-page browser app with the provided framework, served by vite, rendering to the canvas with id #app. The scene is a magic portal standing in an ancient stone ruin at dusk. Build a tall ring portal (a standing circular frame of weathered stone or runic metal) on a stone platform, with moody dusk lighting and a few ruined pillars around it. The disc inside the ring is a swirling, glowing energy surface, such as a rotating vortex in cyan and violet with a bright core, animated continuously. Glowing particles spiral around and into the portal, and a few motes rise from the platform and drift upward, fading out. The portal casts colored light onto the nearby stones and platform, and the light should pulse slowly. Add a subtle slow orbiting camera or gentle camera sway so depth is apparent. Aim for a polished, atmospheric look: strong bloom-like glow around the portal, high contrast against a darker surround, a coherent color palette, and soft haze. Keep it smooth at interactive frame rates. Also expose window.__TASK_STATE__ = { portalActive: true, particleCount: <number of live particles>, time: <elapsed seconds> } and update it every frame.
functionalChecklist: Single-page app boots with vite and renders to the canvas with id #app without console errors
Scene contains a ring-shaped portal frame and a platform or ground made of distinct geometry (not one flat quad)
The portal disc is a visibly animated surface (rotating or swirling pattern via shader, texture animation, or layered rotating meshes)
At least 100 particles orbit or spiral toward the portal and at least some rise and fade out
Portal emits colored light that falls on nearby geometry (a point light or equivalent) and its intensity pulses over time
Glow or bloom-like emphasis is applied to the portal and particles
Camera moves slowly (orbit or sway) or is user-orbitable, and ruined pillars or other surrounding props are present
window.__TASK_STATE__ is updated each frame with portalActive true, a particleCount above 100, and time that increases (probe)
visualRubric: A strong frame shows a clearly readable stone ring portal filled with a luminous swirling cyan-violet vortex with a bright core, surrounded by spiraling glowing particles, set against a darker dusk environment where nearby stones pick up colored light from the portal. Score 1-5 on each: (1) Portal construction: well-modeled frame with believable material and detail, readable silhouette. (2) Energy effect: convincing swirling disc, bright core, smooth gradients with no hard banding or obvious texture seams. (3) Particles and glow: abundant soft glowing motes with varied size and brightness, bloom halo that is strong without blowing out the frame. (4) Lighting and atmosphere: colored light spill and shadows on platform and ruins, haze or fog depth, good contrast. (5) Composition and polish: portal is the focal point, pleasing framing and palette, no clipping, z-fighting, or placeholder-looking geometry, and frames differ naturally over time.
probe: Frame-difference motion check: capture 6 frames at 500 ms intervals after a 2 s warm-up; compute mean absolute per-pixel difference between consecutive frames on a downscaled grayscale image and require it to exceed a small threshold (for example > 0.3 percent of full range) in at least 4 of 5 pairs, with the frame not blank (mean luminance between 5 and 120 on 0-255). Additionally, check that the central region of the frame (portal area) has higher mean luminance than the outer border region by at least 15 percent in the majority of frames. Read window.__TASK_STATE__ at the first and last capture and require portalActive === true, particleCount > 100, and time strictly increasing.
